adapter: linters.ts runEslintPass: eslint --fix ., stylelint --fix --allow-empty-input '**/*.{css,scss,less}', prettier --write ., eslint -f json-with-metadata .
config: what `ultracite init --linter eslint` writes (eslint.config.mjs spreading ultracite/eslint/core, prettier.config.mjs with prettier-plugin-tailwindcss, stylelint.config.mjs), passed with --config and importing the presets by absolute URL
filter: sort-keys, plus any other diagnostic not among the prepared project's own (rule and message, file by file, as diff.ts matches them): a project that lints clean apart from the keys. Every re-lint uses the same filter.
